name: Seafile
tagline: Lean file sync that stays fast with millions of files
description: A file sync and share server built for performance. Files are organised into libraries, synced at block level and deduplicated; a drive client shows everything without downloading it. Collaborative documents and a wiki are included.
licenseNote: The Community Edition server is open source (the web interface is Apache-2.0). The Professional Edition, free for up to three users, adds features such as full-text search and audit logs.
backing: Seafile Ltd., a company based in China, funded by Professional Edition licences

maturity.rationale: In production at universities and research institutes for over a decade and noticeably faster than Nextcloud at pure sync. The community is smaller and the documentation thinner.

selfHosting.summary: An official Docker Compose setup with a database and cache alongside. There are fewer moving parts than in Nextcloud, but the documentation assumes more of you and upgrades between major versions involve manual steps.

strengths: Block-level sync and deduplication make it quick with large files and huge folders
The drive client offers on-demand files on Windows, macOS and Linux
Low resource use for the number of users it serves
Libraries can be encrypted on the client with a password the server never sees
weaknesses: Files are stored as deduplicated blocks, not as plain files on disk; getting them back without Seafile's own tools is not trivial
Far fewer integrations than Nextcloud: it is a file platform, not a workspace
Some features you may expect, such as full-text search, are Professional Edition only
A smaller English-language community when you need help

featureNotes.e2ee: Encrypted libraries protect contents, not file names or sizes
